title: Dynamic Memory Allocation
goal: Stack vs heap, malloc/calloc/realloc/free, leaks, dangling/double free aur ownership.
definition: Dynamic memory runtime par heap se allocate hoti hai: malloc, calloc, realloc aur free. Lifetime programmer ke control me hoti hai.
explain: Stack automatic hai (scope se free), heap manual. malloc bytes leta hai aur uninitialized memory deta hai; calloc count*size leta hai aur zero karta hai; realloc resize karta hai (address badal sakta hai).
malloc NULL return kar sakta hai — hamesha check karo. free(NULL) safe hai; double free aur use-after-free UB hain.
Memory leak tab hota hai jab pointer kho jaata hai par memory free nahi hoti. Ownership ka rule likho: kis function ne allocate kiya aur kaun free karega.
sizeof *p pattern use karo: int *p = malloc(n * sizeof *p); type badalne par bhi sahi rehta hai.
analogy: Heap ek library hai jahan aap kitabein mangwate ho (malloc) aur wapas karte ho (free). Wapas na karo to library bhar jaati hai; wapas karke dobara padho to invalid.
why: Dynamic arrays, linked lists, trees, strings builder aur har real application heap use karti hai. Leak aur use-after-free production incidents ka common karan hain.

syntax.note: Check, use, free, NULL — chaar steps.
realloc ka return naye pointer me lo; fail par purana valid rehta hai.

topics.title: Stack vs heap
topics.body: Stack fast, automatic, chhota (MBs). Heap bada, manual, slower. Large arrays aur runtime-size data heap par.

topics.title: malloc/calloc/realloc/free
topics.body: malloc uninitialized, calloc zeroed. realloc content preserve karta hai naye size tak; fail par NULL aur original intact. free sirf malloc family ke pointer par.

topics.title: Leaks aur invalid access
topics.body: Leak: ownership kho gayi. Dangling: free ke baad use. Double free: same pointer do baar free. Use-after-free: freed memory read/write. ASan teeno pakadta hai.

topics.title: Ownership patterns
topics.body: Ek clear owner; transfer document karo. Cleanup ke liye goto cleanup pattern. Dynamic array struct {T *data; size_t len, cap;} ke saath grow karo.

examples.title: malloc aur free
lines: malloc fail par NULL — check kiya.
free ke baad NULL set kiya.

examples.title: realloc se dynamic array grow
lines: Capacity double hoti hai jab full ho.
realloc ka result tmp me liya — fail par a safe.

mistakes.wrong: int *p = malloc(n * sizeof(int)); p = p + 1; free(p);
mistakes.why: free ko malloc ka original address chahiye.

mistakes.right: tmp = realloc(p, size); if (tmp) p = tmp;
mistakes.why: Fail par NULL se original kho jaata hai — leak.

debug.brief: Loop me memory leak ho raha hai. Fix karo.

interview.q: Memory leak production me kaise pakdein?
interview.a: ASan/Valgrind se development me, heap profiler se production me, aur ownership review se. Har malloc ka ek clear free path hona chahiye.

interview.q: realloc fail hone par kya hota hai?
interview.a: NULL return karta hai aur original block valid rehta hai. Isliye result tmp me lo, warna original pointer kho kar leak ho jaata hai.
interview.followUp: Size 0? — implementation-defined; free jaisa treat karo.
